About.title: About me
About.p1: Senior AI and Full-Stack engineer residing in South Korea — from Uzbekistan, living and working in Korea since 2023; fluent in Korean, English, and Russian.
About.p2: Engineered full-featured platforms utilizing Java 17, Spring Boot, MyBatis, and sharded MySQL/PostgreSQL clusters for backend, paired with Next.js and TypeScript for modern frontends.
About.p3: Built custom enterprise LLM platforms: fine-tuned LoRA Qwen/Llama classifiers outperforming gpt-4o on proprietary benchmarks with zero query inference cost, featuring multi-lingual streaming copilot capabilities.
About.p4: Integrates premier LLM foundation models (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini), TypeScript ecosystem (Node.js, NestJS, React, Next.js) streaming AI assistants, voice-to-text (STT/TTS), and containerized deployments across Docker, NGINX, Linux, AWS, and GCP.

card.title: Blue Networks: E-Chae-Um & AI Power Demand Forecasting Platform
card.description: Enterprise EV Charging Station Management System (CSMS) managing 1,600+ chargers across Korea and an 8-model AI ensemble platform (PyTorch LSTM, XGBoost, EVT) delivering probabilistic P50/P90 power demand forecasts to optimize KEPCO contracted capacity and reduce peak surcharges.
card.techStack: Java 17 · Spring Boot · MyBatis · Python (FastAPI) · PyTorch (LSTM) · XGBoost · SvelteKit · PostgreSQL · Redis · Docker
